name: Aru Fukou ni Miirareta Seinen to no 7 Kakan
original_name: ある不幸に魅入られた青年との７日間
source:
Main character awakens in the field with amnesia. He starts to work on a farm and talk with villagers in attempt to restore memory.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
